data.name: Novum Hex
data.detailed_description:
Novum Hex is a ability based exploration puzzle game. Use abilities to avoid dangers, work your way through environments and get out of the simulation!

This game is a student made game, ran by me, a solo developer. I am developing this through my final year of university and will continue developing it after I leave this summer!

Co-op Or Singleplayer

Attempt the world as a team or solo, bringing new challenges for different groups and allowing everyone to enjoy the game in new and unique ways. Choose between 4 starting abilities and learn how to use them as they develop and progress throughout the levels.

Challenge the environment

Work your way through many hazards, blockages and problems as you try and escape this new world. Discover how to traverse the world and how to unlock the next level in time!

Don't Get Reset!

Take your time figuring out the right path! But do not leave it too long and risk being plunged into the reset! Where the world becomes fragmented, the music breaks down and even more risks lie everywhere. 

Don't Die!

The simulation doesn't take kindly to having to use more resources! For every player death you risk getting closer and closer to getting reset, get out of that world before it happens!

This game is a long development process, I will keep updating my processes as I develop but times will be longer while having to manage this with life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: To Be Updated With Info As Tested Publicly
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.0 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or RX 7600xt or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
